content: We, Adán-e-wagan-nugmar-narmakar-mamaid-e-gardad. Bab-Dummad dule-obinnisgua, deunni na e-sunnague dule-imaksad.
Bab-Dummad machered ome-ebogwa obinnisad. Wemargi ise-nued binsasad. Bab-Dummad dulemar-obinnisgua, amarga sogsad: “Bemar, duleye nugguoye.”

content.text: Adán, machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Degisoggu, Adán bela birga-dulataled-ilabakebak gaka durgwen-gakambe (930) dula-gudii gusad.
A-sorba, Set birga-dulataled-ilabaabak gakagugle (807) napi-gudii gusad.
Set, machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Degisoggu, Set, bela birga-dulataled-ilabakebak gakambe-gakabo (912) dula-gudii gusad.
A-sorbali, Enós, birga-dulataled-ilabaabak gakambe-gakatar (815) napi-gudii gusad.
Enós, machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Degisoggu, Enós, bela birga-dulataled-ilabakebak gakatar (905) dula-gudii gusad.
A-sorbali, Cainán, birga-dulataled-ilabaabak gaka dulabo (840) napi-gudii gusad.
Cainán, machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Degisoggu, Cainán, bela birga-dulataled-ilabakebak gakambe (910) dula-gudii gusad.
A-sorba, Mahalaleel, birga-dulataled-ilabaabak gaka dulagwen-gakambe (830) napi-gudii gusad.
Mahalaleel, machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Degisoggu, Mahalaleel, bela birga-dulataled-ilabaabak gaka dulabake-gakambe-gakatar (895) dula-gudii gusad.
Jared, machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Degisoggu, Jared, bela birga-dulataled-ilabakebak gaka dulapaa-gakabo (962) dula-gudii gusad.
Enoc, machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Degisoggu, Enoc, bela birga-dulataled-ilapaa gaka dulapaa-gakatar (365) dula-gudii gusad.
Ar Enoc, Bab-Dummad-walikaa nanadii gussoggu, ibagwengi sate daklealid,
A-sorba, Matusalén, birga-dulataled-ilagugle gaka dulabake-gakabo (782) napi-gudii gusad.
Matusalén, machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Degisoggu, Matusalén, bela birga-dulataled-ilabakebak gaka dulapaa-gakabakebak (969) dula-gudii gusad.
Ar ade, sogded: “Bab-Jehová we-napa-ukabsassoggu, a-ular, anmar ise-alamaknai arbaergebed.
Ar emigindi, we-machigwa anmarga obunnoged ukoed.”
Noé-gwalulesad-sorba, Lamec, birga-dulataled-ilatar gaka dulabake-gakambe-gakatar (595) napi-gudii gusad.
Lamec, machimala-baigan nikusbalid, degine, bunamala nikusbalid.
Degisoggu, Lamec, bela birga-dulataled-ilagugle gaka dulapaa-gakambe-gakagugle (777) dula-gudii gusad.
